name: sdr2hdr-gainmap
description: Single-file local web app: convert SDR JPG/PNG photos into HDR JPEGs with a gain map (Ultra HDR style).

scripts.check: node --check tools/test_encode.js && node --check tools/test_ui.js && python3 -m py_compile tools/validate_output.py tools/make_test_images.py && test -f index.html && grep -q "__hdrApp" index.html
